name: YuXin Little Magic Megaminx
description: The YuXin Little Magic Megaminx is the first megaminx ever released by YuXin. As a budget-friendly megaminx, the YuXin Megaminx is surprisingly advanced. It features highly rounded pieces for enhanced corner-cutting and a ridged design along the edges to help with grip. Additionally, the YuXin Megaminx is the lightest megaminx on the market.
